_comment: Model configuration for Claude API proxy. Updated automatically by update_models.php or manually.

glm._comment: Non-Anthropic model served by Z.AI (Zhipu), via an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Replaces the old Fable tier as the default — see api-proxy.php callOpenAiCompatibleApi(). Pricing is the blended rate from the actual purchased balance ($19.90 / 20M tokens = $0.995/MTok), NOT Z.AI's published list price (input $1.40 / output $4.40 per MTok) — confirm with John whether usage is actually metered separately before trusting cost totals long-term.

kimi._comment: Non-Anthropic model served by Moonshot AI, via an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (kimi-k3 has native vision support, but this proxy doesn't translate to OpenAI's image_url format yet, so images are rejected for this tier same as glm). Pricing is Moonshot's standard/cache-miss rate ($3.00 in / $15.00 out per MTok) — their $0.30/MTok cache-hit discount isn't modeled since this proxy sends no cache hints.

dsflash._comment: DeepSeek V4 Flash — cheap/fast text model, OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Pricing is the off-peak cache-miss rate from api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing (peak hours 01:00-04:00 & 06:00-10:00 UTC fall outside school hours, so off-peak is the realistic rate).

dspro._comment: DeepSeek V4 Pro — higher-capability text model, same endpoint/provider as dsflash. Pricing is the off-peak cache-miss rate.

dsvision._comment: DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision (experimental) — same text pricing/capability as dsflash, but supportsVision=true lets api-proxy.php translate Anthropic-style image blocks into OpenAI's image_url format instead of rejecting them. Images are billed at the input rate, up to 384 tokens each.
